Triage: lands in `area:fleet` · `domain:devx` · `priority:p2` · Bug · `pm:queue` · size XS. This follows the precedent of the previous watchdog card #35297.
Rationale: the platform-checklist gate is a QA ledger and not a per-PR code gate, so this is not p0. Main CI, push and merge queue, is green. It is p2 because, while it is red, checklist authoring and checklist-test runs read a broken ledger.
Cause, read on main f77d078d: PR #36697 (c45dd80f) moved `anonymousFormExplicitWithdrawals` from `packages/metadata-core/src/anonymous-form-intake.ts` into `packages/spec/src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.ts`. The two anchors in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json` (lines 1838 and 1877) still name the old file. The fix is to re-point both anchors, as the gate output says.

triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Second report of this red, from repo:objectstack#3 (mailbox #36743, comment 7123473856, item 1). It was read on main at 5c2e34cdb and d9c799c10 and has the same cause. No new card is filed, so this card stays the one place for it.

A note for whoever re-anchors it: the maintainer paused public-forms development at 05:23Z pending #36868, which splits forms out into their own `form` metadata type. The fix here is still only to re-point the two anchors at `packages/spec/src/ui/anonymous-form-intake.ts`, where the symbol lives now. If #36868's work moves the symbol again, the anchors follow it there.
